summary: Develop software models using industry-standard tools such as Simulink, Stateflow, or similar. Collaborate with system engineers to ensure that software models accurately reflect system behavior and requirements.
responsibilities: Develop software models using industry-standard tools such as Simulink, Stateflow, or similar.
Translate system requirements into executable models and generate code for embedded systems.
Collaborate with system engineers to ensure that software models accurately reflect system behavior and requirements.
Perform model verification and validation to ensure the correctness and robustness of the software.
Work closely with software and hardware teams to integrate model-based software with other system components.
Participate in code reviews, testing, and debugging activities to maintain high software quality standards.
Stay up-to-date with the latest advancements in model-based development techniques and tools.
required_skills: Bachelor's degree in Electronic and E&TC Engineering, or a related field.
3-5 years of experience in model-based software development.
Proficiency in model-based development tools such as Simulink, Stateflow, or similar.
Strong understanding of software engineering principles and best practices.
Experience with embedded systems development and real-time operating systems.
nice_to_have_skills: Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
